snippet.title: Feeble Origins: Path of a Hero - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now for Steam and Xbox One. 1.0 Release in March 2026!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/345020/A_Feeble_Saga
https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9N1SQXBHMBP7

Explore a rich, hand-crafted fantasy adventure where every upgrade has meaningful impact. Begin as a mistrusted outlander who will descend ancient caves and tombs, navigate an expansive non-linear world, and reveal a twisted plot to rise and become the hero your fractured town never saw coming.
